workflows.name: Morning Brief
workflows.description: Every morning at 7am PST: pull overnight Discord signals, Hyper Liquid portfolio snapshot, market volume metrics, YouTube insights from last 24h, and news digest. Send consolidated daily letter to Greg via Telegram.

validation_gates.description: Portfolio data matches Hyper Liquid API response
Brief delivered to Telegram successfully
Signal count sanity check (0-50 signals in 24h is normal; alert if >100 or 0 for >24h)

workflows.name: Discord Signal Scraper
workflows.description: Every 15 minutes: connect to Discord API, fetch new messages from monitored trade-signal channels, parse for structured signals (ticker, direction, entry, TP, SL), filter noise, and log to daily signal file. High-quality signals trigger an immediate Telegram alert.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg specifies which Discord channels to monitor — updated on request

validation_gates.description: Signal parsed with all required fields: ticker, direction, entry, TP, SL, source, timestamp
No duplicate signals from same source within 1 hour
Quality filter: confidence score > 0.7 before Telegram alert

workflows.name: Position Monitor & Stop-Loss Guard
workflows.description: Every 15 minutes: fetch all open Hyper Liquid positions, verify each has a stop-loss set, calculate drawdown vs threshold, log portfolio snapshot. Alert Greg via Telegram immediately if any position is missing a stop-loss or if portfolio drawdown exceeds defined threshold.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg manually executes any stop-loss or risk action — agent never trades autonomously

validation_gates.description: Drawdown alert threshold defined before activation (e.g. >10% portfolio drawdown)
De-duplicate alerts: don't re-alert same position within 30 minutes
Alert includes: position, current price, drawdown %, recommended action

workflows.name: Trade Journal & Performance Tracker
workflows.description: On every position close event (detected via Hyper Liquid API): log entry, exit, P&L, duration, stop-loss used, TP used, outcome classification (target_hit / stopped_out / manual_close). Update running win rate and avg P&L. Weekly: generate performance summary with pattern analysis.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg reviews weekly performance summary and adds context/notes

validation_gates.description: P&L logged matches Hyper Liquid confirmed P&L
All required fields populated for each trade record
Running win rate and avg P&L calculations are accurate

workflows.name: Run Backtest
workflows.description: On demand or nightly: execute a backtest for a named strategy over a specified historical window. Fetch OHLCV data from Hyper Liquid, apply entry/exit rules, calculate metrics (total return, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, avg P&L). Summarize top 5 metrics + strengths/weaknesses. Store results tagged by strategy + date.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg provides: strategy name, parameters, asset, timeframe, date range
Greg reviews backtest report and decides next steps

validation_gates.description: OHLCV data completeness check: no gaps in historical data for the specified range
All 5 core metrics included: total return, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, avg P&L
Minimum trade count for statistical significance (>30 trades)

workflows.name: Strategy Optimizer
workflows.description: On demand: run parameter sweeps (grid search or Bayesian) to find optimal settings for a named strategy. Rank combinations by Sharpe ratio. Validate top 3 configs on holdout period to check for overfitting. Report: best params, performance, overfitting risk flag.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg defines parameter ranges to sweep
Greg selects which config to deploy from top 3 candidates

validation_gates.description: Overfitting check: top config must perform within 80% of in-sample on holdout period
Report includes: in-sample and out-of-sample metrics for each top config
Minimum parameter combinations tested before reporting

workflows.name: Generate Chart
workflows.description: On demand (Greg-triggered or post-trade-proposal): fetch OHLCV data from Hyper Liquid, render chart with requested indicators (MA, RSI, MACD, volume, etc.) as PNG, deliver via Telegram. Not automatically generated — Greg requests it.

validation_gates.description: Chart renders without error and is delivered to Telegram
All requested indicators applied correctly

workflows.name: YouTube Trading Intelligence Scraper
workflows.description: Daily overnight: query YouTube API for new videos from Greg's tracked trading channels. Download transcripts/descriptions. Summarize key insights (strategy ideas, risk tips, market analysis). Store summaries with tags. Top 2-3 insights included in morning brief.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg specifies which YouTube channels to track — updated on request

validation_gates.description: Summary includes: video title, channel, key insight, relevance score
Only include videos with relevance score >0.6 in morning brief
Don't re-summarize videos already processed

workflows.name: Paper Trading System
workflows.description: Simulate trades using real-time Hyper Liquid data without capital at risk. When a qualifying Discord signal or backtest-validated strategy generates an entry, execute a simulated trade. Track paper P&L, compare against live performance. Use to validate new strategies before going live.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg approves which strategies run in paper mode
Greg decides when paper performance warrants going live

validation_gates.description: Paper trade logged with same fields as live trade journal
Paper P&L benchmarked against live performance weekly
Minimum paper trade sample (>20 trades) before live recommendation

workflows.name: Volume Spike & Indicator Alert
workflows.description: Heartbeat every 15 minutes: poll configured tickers for volume anomalies and indicator threshold crossings (RSI overbought/oversold, MACD signal cross, etc.). On trigger: send Telegram alert with ticker, context, and optional chart link. Queue chart generation if significant.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg defines: tickers to watch, indicator conditions, volume spike % threshold

validation_gates.description: Don't re-alert same condition on same ticker within 1 hour
Alert only when signal strength is above defined minimum
Alert includes: ticker, condition triggered, current value vs threshold, suggested chart

workflows.name: Risk Management Report
workflows.description: On demand or weekly: analyze all open positions for risk/reward ratios, check stop-loss levels, recommend adjustments (trailing stops, TP tightening). Generate risk summary: per-position risk, correlation risk, portfolio max drawdown scenario. Deliver as Telegram message.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg manually executes any recommended adjustments — agent never trades

validation_gates.description: Position data is current (fetched within 5 minutes)
Report includes: per-position risk, portfolio correlation risk, max drawdown scenario
All recommendations are actionable with specific values

workflows.name: Dataset Scout
workflows.description: Nightly: search for new public datasets that could provide trading edge (on-chain data, social sentiment, options flow, funding rates, whale wallet tracking, etc.). Evaluate each source for quality, update frequency, cost, and API availability. Flag 1-3 promising sources per week in morning brief.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg decides whether to integrate a flagged dataset

validation_gates.description: Each flagged source includes: name, data type, update frequency, cost, API availability, relevance score
Only surface sources with relevance score >0.6

workflows.name: Signal Quality Scorer
workflows.description: After enough trade journal data accumulates: score incoming Discord signals against historical signal quality by source/channel. Weight signals from sources with higher win rates. Flag consistently underperforming signal sources for removal from monitoring list.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg reviews flagged underperforming sources and approves removal from list

validation_gates.description: Minimum 20 historical signals from source before scoring
Score calculation uses closed trades only (no open positions)
Source score card includes: win rate, avg P&L, signal count, trend (improving/declining)

workflows.name: Equity Curve Generator
workflows.description: Called automatically after every backtest: render equity curve with drawdown overlay from backtest output data. Send chart image via Telegram. Attach to backtest report in memory.

validation_gates.description: Equity curve renders without error
Drawdown overlay matches backtest reported max drawdown

workflows.name: Weekly Performance Review
workflows.description: Every Sunday: compile weekly trading performance from trade journal. Metrics: total P&L, win rate, best/worst trade, avg hold time, drawdown this week vs account peak. Pattern analysis: recurring mistakes, what strategies are working. Delivered as Telegram message with optional chart.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg can add notes or context to the performance log for that week

validation_gates.description: Weekly P&L matches sum of individual trade journal entries
All 6 core metrics included
Patterns identified are grounded in actual trade data, not assumptions

workflows.name: Strategy Live-Ready Validator
workflows.description: Before any new strategy goes live: run full validation checklist — backtest results (>30 trades, Sharpe >1.0), paper trading results (>20 trades), max drawdown within tolerance, position sizing rules defined, stop-loss logic present. Generate go/no-go report for Greg.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg reviews go/no-go report and makes final call to deploy strategy

validation_gates.description: Backtest: >30 trades, Sharpe >1.0, max drawdown within tolerance
Paper trading results consistent with backtest expectations
Report explicitly lists: what passed, what failed, what's borderline

workflows.name: Trade Proposal Builder
workflows.description: When Sebastian (main agent) identifies a high-confidence trade setup from Discord signals + indicator alignment: generate a structured trade proposal. Includes: ticker, direction, entry zone, TP target, SL level, risk/reward ratio, supporting signal sources, recommended position size (% of account). Sent via Telegram as a card for Greg to approve or skip.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg approves or skips each trade proposal — agent never executes trades

validation_gates.description: Proposal includes all 7 required fields: ticker, direction, entry, TP, SL, R:R, position size
R:R ratio minimum 2:1 before proposal is generated
At least 2 independent confirming signals before proposal fires

workflows.name: OpenClaw Setup & Health Check
workflows.description: Initial setup skill + ongoing health monitoring: verify all API connections (Hyper Liquid, Discord, YouTube, Telegram), check agent heartbeats, confirm secrets are loaded, test signal pipeline end-to-end. Run on first deploy and weekly thereafter.

human_in_the_loop.description: Greg provides updated API keys if any connection fails

validation_gates.description: All API connections return healthy status
All agent heartbeats responding
Health check report delivered via Telegram

build_phases.name: Foundation — Eyes Open
build_phases.description: Get the agent observing. No trade execution. Greg gets daily intel with zero manual work.

build_phases.name: Memory — Learn From Every Trade
build_phases.description: Agent starts logging and learning. Trade journal builds the data foundation for everything downstream.

build_phases.name: Edge — Backtesting & Validation
build_phases.description: Quant agent comes online. Strategies get tested, optimized, and validated before any live capital.

build_phases.name: Intelligence — Synthesis & Proposals
build_phases.description: Agent synthesizes signals, scores sources, validates strategies, and generates trade proposals. Greg still pulls the trigger but the agent does all the pre-work.

notes.no_autonomous_trading: CRITICAL: Agent never executes live trades. All trade proposals require Greg's explicit approval. Blast radius on all trade-related workflows is strictly notification/proposal only.
notes.model_config: GLM-4.7 (Z.AI subscription) as brain + DeepSeek V3 as muscle/coder. Per tool_inventory.json Greg specified GLM-4.7.
notes.phase1_quickwin: WF-001 (Morning Brief) + WF-002 (Discord Scraper) are the highest-value, lowest-effort starting point. Get these live first.
